sentences.en: In the class role-play game, Paul has to unmask the traitor.
sentences.ko: 반 역할 놀이에서 폴은 배신자를 밝혀내야 해요.

sentences.text: Grâce à une enquête interne, Émilie a pu démasquer le faux compte.
sentences.en: Thanks to an internal investigation, Émilie was able to expose the fake account.
sentences.ko: 내부 조사 덕분에 에밀리는 가짜 계정을 밝혀낼 수 있었어요.

sentences.text: La sonnerie aiguë fait sursauter Paul à chaque fois.
sentences.en: The shrill bell makes Paul jump every time.
sentences.ko: 날카로운 종소리에 폴은 매번 깜짝 놀라요.

sentences.text: Avant la démo, Émilie ressent une douleur aiguë dans le dos.
sentences.en: Before the demo, Émilie feels a sharp pain in her back.
sentences.ko: 시연 전에 에밀리는 등에 날카로운 통증을 느껴요.
